resources.string: Hidden dock: Down (or OK) brings it back, Back puts it away. To take an app out of the dock, hold OK (or Menu) on it and choose Remove from dock.
Big app name above the dock
Gear opens these settings (hold OK: menu)
Add-ons are small apps that put a card on Home (weather, world clock, sleep timer…). Installed now: %1$d. They are built and installed from the computer, from the repo\'s addons folder.
Hide the apps under the dock (Down shows them)
Every choice made on this screen goes back to the theme: the dock, wallpaper timing, widgets and effects. The dock order stays.
Speed in the corner, over every app
The add-on may not draw over other apps yet: allow it with adb (appops set local.tvhome.netspeed SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW allow).
Sun, moon and meteor showers under the clock
New Year countdown with a fir tree
OK picks a widget up. Up and Down change the order, Left and Right the side. OK or Back sets it down.
Straw pavuk (BY, PL, LT, LV, UA)
TIME LEFT TILL THE NEW YEAR

Claude: warm charcoal and clay, its own drawn wallpaper, glass with a rim, dark pills under the widgets. Made by Claude Code with the owner of this TV, 28 October 2026. Switching back restores exactly what was set before.
Right: +30 s · Left: −30 s · Back: close
Go into the settings (Right): for the focused row this pane says what it does, its value now and what the other values would do.
Up, Down: category · Right or OK: into its settings · Back: leave
OK or Right: next value · Left: previous · Back: categories
OK: open · Left or Back: categories
A ready-made look: colours, wallpaper and highlight style in one choice. Your own settings come back when you switch back.
the installed theme and your own settings decide
warm charcoal and clay, the drawn "claude code" wallpaper, rimmed glass, dark pills under the widgets
Tiles per row and places in the dock. More columns: smaller tiles, more apps on screen.
How many rows of apps show under the dock while it has focus. 0: only the edge of the next row.
How the app dock behaves on Home.
hides when the remote is idle; Down or OK brings it back, Back puts it away
put away with only a ^ mark; Down pulls the apps out
Seconds without a key press before the dock hides, in the autohide and drawer modes.
On: while the dock has focus the apps under it stay hidden; Down shows them all. Off: the next row always peeks in.
On: free dock places take apps from the list. Off: the dock shrinks to your apps, centred; with none it disappears.
Every app in one row that scrolls sideways; no list under the dock.
A see-through band behind the dock apps so they stand out on the wallpaper.
The dock band as frosted glass (the wallpaper shows through) instead of dark.
How solid the dock band is: 100% solid, 30% barely there.
The focused dock app\'s name shows large above the dock.
Reorder apps on Home: OK picks one up, arrows move it, OK puts it down, Back saves.
Opens every wallpaper as thumbnails: pick one, none, or go back to the rotation (Theme).
How often the wallpaper changes. Off: always the same. It changes only while Home is on screen.
Whether the wallpaper changes on the clock.
exactly on the interval: 19:00, 20:00 for "1 h"
an interval after the last change, at any time
The order the wallpapers come in.
one after another, by file name
Darkens the wallpaper so text and tiles read better. 0%: as it is.
On: a name under every tile. Off: only under the focused tile.
The size of the names under the tiles.
How heavy the names are: regular, medium or bold.
Space between letters in the names. More reads better from afar, but long names are cut sooner.
Every tile alike: the app\'s icon large on a plain tile instead of its banner.
Smooth focus, tiles appearing, widget and celebration motion. Off: everything instant, less work for the TV.
The focused tile lifts, its icon grows and colours blend. Uses more memory; needs Animations on.
The highlight glows in the focused app\'s colour.
A soft glow of the focused app\'s colour behind the tiles.
Rows fade out at the top as the list scrolls.
The highlight overshoots a little and springs back on each move.
Shorter, simpler motion for weak TVs.
a glass plate around the tile
Above the clock: good morning, afternoon or evening, by sunrise and sunset.
Where the date goes: beside the clock or under it (when the buttons need the room).
The clock and date always in white, not the theme\'s colour.
A soft glow around the clock digits.
The network button at the top right: shows the connection and opens network settings.
The network button takes the colour of the Wi-Fi signal strength.
The inputs button (HDMI, TV) at the top right.
The top buttons as icons only, without labels.
On: the gear opens these settings (hold OK for the menu). Off: it opens the TV\'s settings.
Order and side of the widgets: under the clock or on the right. OK picks one up, arrows move it.
Space between widgets and from the clock, and between lines inside a widget.
A backdrop behind each widget so it reads on a bright wallpaper. Its colour and look are below.
The colour of the widgets\' backdrop.
How solid the backdrop is: 0% invisible, 100% solid.
Whether the backdrop is even or fades to one side.
solid at the top, fading down
solid on the left, fading right
How round the backdrop\'s corners are. 0: square.
A thin light border around the backdrop.

Three lines with icons: sunrise, sunset and day length; the moon\'s phase, rise, set and next new or full moon; meteor showers tonight. Place: Minsk. Worked out offline, current as soon as the date changes.
A line with memory used and total, and free storage.
How often the line is read. It is not read at all while another app is open.
A widget with a festive symbol and the time left in days and HH:MM:SS. It moves only on Home. At midnight, five minutes of celebration, then the count to next year.
Which festive symbol the widget draws.
a fir tree with blinking lights and a star
the carollers\' star on a pole with ribbons (BY, UA, PL)
a turning straw pavuk with small ones hanging (BY, PL, LT, LV, UA)
the Ukrainian wheat sheaf with a red band
snow over the widget and one big flake
Which day to count to: New Year (1 Jan), Christmas (25 Dec) or Orthodox Christmas (7 Jan). The title and greeting follow.
How the title above the countdown reads.
Plays the five-minute celebration over your wallpaper. Right and Left skip 30 s.
Minutes without a key press on Home before the big clock opens. Off: never.
The big clock shows over the wallpaper, not on black.
The "↓ ↑" network speed line in the bottom right corner, over every app. The one widget that runs outside Home.
How often the speed is measured, 0.1 to 10 s. More often is more exact but a little more work.
B/s, KB/s, MB/s, like file sizes
b/s, Kb/s, Mb/s, like a provider\'s plan
The add-ons with cards on Home: show or hide each.
Whether to look for installed add-ons\' cards and ask to show them.
An app to open right after the TV turns on.
Opens the system\'s home screen choice, to go back to the stock one or pick this again.
Resets every choice made here to the theme\'s. Asks first. The app order stays.
